control: A guest creates an Xbox graphics pipeline with vertex and pixel DXIL, binds the wrapped root signature, PSO and RTV, clears a 16x16 target, draws a full-screen triangle with a 6x6 scissor and reads all 256 pixels after the fence. The topology call follows the observed guest capacity check.
limits: The control uses portable DXIL, zero Xbox pipeline extensions and an empty pipeline cache record. Native Scarlett shader translation, derived PSOs, and retail frame output are outside this control.
